title: RAW UNREVIEWED: fochor name claim against positional Herbal-head base rates
summary: A first-position form may be a plant name, an entry formula, or an index key. Freeze a matched census of admitted Herbal heads and their exact whole-form recurrence, page roles and image-owner keys before fitting fochor. Taxon-conditioned behavior would favor naming; uniform first-position behavior would favor generic heading. One occurrence of fochor may leave the hypotheses indistinguishable; no new semantic binding is implied by head position alone.

design.mechanism: Name-bearing heads covary with independently keyed plant identity, while generic entry heads covary with position or record type.
design.unit: Exact first prose whole on each already admitted Herbal page, matched by layout and transcription coverage.
design.contrast: independent plant-owner selectivity versus positional heading null
design.prediction: The fixed owner labels explain head-form identity or declared related forms beyond matched layout and frequency controls; if fochor remains a singleton without a related owner, return no capacity.
design.scope: Raw census proposal; predecessor GDT1059 must be checked before selection.
